top_signals.title: BAI Capital Closing in on $800 Million for New USD Fund
top_signals.summary: BAI Capital's Managing Partner Annabelle Yu Long told Bloomberg that the firm is nearing $700 million of an $800 million target as it attracts European LPs and Chinese strategic investors. (Source: Bloomberg)
